provenance.generator: Codex assistant, paper-guided reconstruction; not historical GPT-4 outputs
provenance.scope: UT-Zappos primitive labels only; no image inspection, validation labels or test metrics used
provenance.notice: Material descriptions are plausible semantic cues, not guarantees that a material can be identified from an image. This is a method reconstruction, not an exact reproduction of the original knowledge corpus.

encoding: regex English words -> mean available GloVe 6B 300d -> L2 normalize; coverage >= 0.8
pair_prior: none: no split-derived compatibility matrix is constructed
control: Same primitive derangements as text inputs; OI/labels/names unchanged
